declared_dimensions.N_artifacts: Length of the chronological workload-artifact stream processed by a method.
declared_dimensions.K_invocations: Executed workload requests charged for one deployed artifact.
declared_dimensions.trace_q25: Lower-quartile successful request count per nonempty deployed model identity.

decision_rules.rule: A request count for repeated use of the same model may justify K-invocations but may not be relabeled as N-artifacts.
A distinct stable model identity may count as one external artifact arrival only once, at first appearance.
An external artifact-stream N-star is executable only if the frozen heldout harness can supply at least that many prospectively selected artifacts under its committed procedure.
A cross-domain mapping must preserve the counted event: request to execution and model identity to compiled artifact.
If units or executable stream capacity disagree, P2 remains incomplete and the invocation-trace stop condition remains active.

candidate_mappings.mapping: trace q25 successful requests per model -> Foundry N-star artifact stream length
trace q25 successful requests per model -> K-star executions charged per Foundry artifact
86 distinct trace model identities -> Foundry N-star artifact stream length
candidate_mappings.required_unit: artifact arrivals plus heldout capacity of at least 86 artifacts

forbidden: Do not silently change the Foundry-0 definition of N.
Do not count repeated requests as newly discovered artifacts.
Do not infer 86 heldout artifacts from four frozen source identities.
Do not inspect validation-v6 source, runtime, graphs, or outcomes.
